NP Presspad 1.3.0 — Spelling corrections, and a right-click menu

The editor has always underlined misspelled words, but there was no way to reach the corrections. Now there is. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Right-click menu

Right-clicking in the editor previously did nothing at all. It now opens a proper menu:

- **Spelling suggestions** for the underlined word, and **Add to Dictionary** for the ones that aren't really mistakes — names, jargon, your own coinages.
- **Copy Link** when you right-click a link.
- **Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All**, which were also unreachable by right-click before.
- **Paste and Match Style**, for pasting from a web page without dragging its formatting along with it. It appears in the post body, where formatting can exist, and not in plain fields like the title.

The menu works everywhere you type, including popped-out scratchpad windows.

## Under the hood

- The database engine moved to a new build that works across Node and Electron without being recompiled for each. Your existing content is unaffected — this was verified in both directions before shipping, so an older version can still open a database this one has written.
- 20 packages dropped out of the dependency tree along with it.

## Held back

- **@vitejs/plugin-react** 5 → 6 still needs Vite 8, which the current Electron build tooling doesn't support yet. It stays deferred.
